title: SynthAVE: Scalable Synthetic Labeling for E-Commerce with LLM-Arena Validation
abstract: arXiv:2607.07469v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) for e-commerce attribute extraction requires labeled data representative across thousands of product types, attributes, and multiple languages. This combinatorial scale translates to millions of annotations, rendering human labeling prohibitively costly. While recent work has demonstrated synthetic label generation using LLMs, deploying such approaches at industrial scale requires integrated quality control mechanisms. We present SynthAVE, a large-scale benchmark for attribute-value verification spanning 12,726 products across 229 product types, 792 attributes, and 4 languages (Spanish, French, Italian, German). To validate synthetic labels at scale, we introduce a multi-LLM arena framework where each sample is evaluated by 21 judge configurations (7 model families $\times$ 3 prompts), with final labels determined via majority voting; disagreements with the synthetic label are expert-adj

translated_title: SynthAVE：基于LLM竞技场验证的电商可扩展合成标注方法
translated_abstract: 为电商属性提取任务微调大语言模型（LLM）需要覆盖数千种产品类型、属性及多种语言的代表性标注数据。这种组合规模意味着数百万条标注需求，使人工标注成本过高。尽管近期研究已展示利用LLM生成合成标签的方法，但在工业规模上部署此类方案需要集成质量控制机制。我们提出了SynthAVE，一个大规模属性-数值验证基准，涵盖12,726个产品、229种产品类型、792个属性和4种语言（西班牙语、法语、意大利语、德语）。为大规模验证合成标签，我们引入了一种多LLM竞技场框架，每个样本由21个评审配置（7个模型家族 × 3种提示词）进行评估，最终标签通过多数投票确定；与合成标签不一致的情况则由专家裁决（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出SynthAVE——一个涵盖12,726个产品、229种产品类型、792个属性和4种语言的电商属性验证基准，通过由21个LLM评审配置进行多数投票的多LLM竞技场框架，实现了合成标签的大规模质量控制与验证。
en_tdlr: SynthAVE is a large-scale e-commerce attribute-value verification benchmark spanning 12,726 products, 229 product types, 792 attributes, and 4 languages, which validates synthetic labels at scale through a multi-LLM arena framework with 21 judge configurations and majority voting.
